product.name: Monoprice Blackbird 4K Pro HDCP Converter 2.2 to 1.4
product.description: The Monoprice™ Blackbird™ 4K HDCP™ 2.2 to 1.4 Converter is the definitive solution for playback of new 4K HDCP 2.2 encoded content on 4K displays with the old HDCP 1.4 standard. Most 4K televisions sold in the last few years do not support HDCP 2.2, but the Blackbird HDCP Converter keeps your equipment relevant and running.The converter is also a great compatibility solution for AV distribution systems running a mix of new and old 4K displays.
